title: Country Draft
description: Five countries, five rounds. Each country puts three of its people on the table. Take one, give them a seat in your cabinet, and see how much of the map they take.

title: Blind Pick
shortDescription: 8 stats. 8 countries. No idea what comes next.
description: Eight stat categories are on the board. Countries arrive one at a time and you never know what is coming, so you put each one on the stat where it ranks highest in the world. Eight picks, scored against the optimal assignment.

title: Higher or Lower
shortDescription: Keep your streak alive. One wrong pick ends it.
description: Two countries, one stat. Pick which ranks higher. One mistake and your streak dies.

title: GeoWordle
shortDescription: Guess the mystery country in 6 tries.
description: A mystery country is hidden. Each guess reveals how far away you are and which direction to head. Narrow it down and solve it in six tries.

title: Stat Guesser
description: What's the population of Brazil? The GDP of Norway? Guess the number. Closer is better.

title: Flag Quiz
shortDescription: 10 flags. Name the country or fail.
description: A flag appears with four options. Pick the right country. 10 rounds, no second chances.

title: Speed Flags
shortDescription: 20 seconds. How many flags can you name?
description: 20 seconds on the clock. Identify as many flags as you can. Speed and accuracy both count.
